days.title: Mountain Peak and Slopes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: monte San Giorgio
stops.detail: The rocks that make up Monte San Giorgio are part of the Lanzo Ultrabasic Massif, a formation of deep origin.

stops.name: cima dell'omonima montagna
stops.detail: The park protects 377 hectares entirely within the municipality of Piossasco and located at an altitude ranging from 300 to 837 m at the peak of the mountain of the same name.

days.title: Southern Flora and Sangano Slopes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: zona meridionale del parco
stops.detail: In the southern area of the park lies one of the few remaining stations in Piedmont of a rare plant species, the Paeonia officinalis.

stops.name: versante che volge verso Sangano
stops.detail: Salamanders are numerous on the slope facing towards Sangano along with newts; the insects are also interesting, among which a rich and differentiated presence of Carabids stands out.
